title: Newhalo button
description: A 40px button with 4px corners in five looks: hot orange with black text, thin outline, solid foreground fill, a quiet translucent square and a card-coloured arrow tile. On hover the label rolls up and out while a copy rolls in from below (0.35s), and the colours shift (0.3s, a soft ease-out).
notes: light and quiet are meant for black panels: wrap them in a .dark area
the label is a string so the hover copy can be made; pass an icon for the play-style button
